title: SNOW MultiSWAP Runtime Qualification
prequalification_rule: F-MQ24 may proceed to runtime qualification only if a production runtime candidate already composes the exact admitted SNOW process while retaining F-KT transaction and mass authority. If that production capability is missing, F-MQ24 stops BLOCKED_PRE_IMPLEMENTATION and hands the requirement to the runtime implementation owner.
required_runtime_capabilities: SNOW-active profile is admitted by a production runtime route rather than explicitly rejected.
Exact F-VQ16 process implementation is present or source-identically composed.
Persistent snow state is included in per-column transactional continuation state only for snow-active columns.
Daily SNOW event is applied exactly once per accepted one-call interval and is not consumed by rejected trials.
SNOW candidate state participates in checkpoint, rollback, replay and commit through F-KT-owned transaction semantics.
Authoritative mass composition accounts for snow storage and external precipitation/sublimation terms and transfers melt exactly once internally.
Snow-inactive columns retain zero snow allocation/processing overhead beyond lightweight routing metadata.
Per-column results remain bitwise identical to direct F-VQ16 reference calls within the admitted time domain.

qualification_matrix_if_admitted.time: non-midnight exact one-day Snow event only
qualification_matrix_if_admitted.mass: authoritative complete with missing contribution mask zero where the composed boundary is complete

hard_holds: No subdaily or arbitrary-duration SNOW admission.
No silent change to Richards physics, F-SI, F-KT, numerical policy, coupling or fallback behavior.
